evidence.decision: Chooses pass/order/identity model before field hierarchy, lifecycle or minimal verification request.
evidence.artifact: Delivers chosen model field/lifecycle/update contract and corrected artifact.
evidence.transformation: Image-only seat and repeated promotional additions become semantic fields, View route and time-critical updates.
evidence.verification: Fails lost watch essentials, unsupported carrier status and excessive identity attributes.
evidence.applicability: Checks current API/service support and separates watch pass availability from verification capability and runtime encryption proof.
evidence.handoffs: Apple Pay handles payment; ID Verifier handles in-person mobile-ID reading.
evidence.distinctiveness: Semantic fallback fields, absent-versus-existing Add/View and evidence-backed fulfillment states are Wallet-specific.
